answer_2.quote: We calculate log-MAE (LMAE) and exponent accuracy (E-Acc), both of which use log base 10. Both LMAE and E-Acc metrics test the model's argmax prediction and not the entire P (y|X) distribution. ... we report the AUC of a ROC curve for both types as random-anomaly (R-AUC) and string-anomaly (S-AUC) respectively
